exposure: Causes of maternal death (Obstetric hemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, sepsis)
Characteristics of pregnancy-related death (condition at admission, gestational age, antenatal care, mode of delivery, areas of delay)
cohort: Women of reproductive age in Sudan whose maternal mortality data were collected from 2009 to 2019.
finding: The national maternal mortality ratio in Sudan significantly declined by nearly 60% from 2009 to 2019, though with wide regional disparities, and direct causes like obstetric hemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, and sepsis remain critical challenges.
gest_age: Gestational age was considered an important characteristic of pregnancy-related death.
